description: Push-to-talk voice input for coding with AI. Hold a key, talk, release — recognition runs on your own machine and the text lands in any app.
notes: VocalCode is a paid app ($4.99 once) with a 30-day trial — everything is enabled during it.
Run it once to choose a language; the matching speech model is downloaded then, so the
installer itself ships without one and the first launch needs a network connection.
Accuracy numbers and the method behind them: https://vocalcode.app/benchmark/
